file-read.code:
touch x.yara
clamscan --no-summary -d x.yara -f /path/to/input-file 2>&1 | sed -nE 's/^(.*): No such file or directory$/\1/p'
file-read.comment: Each line of the file is interpreted as a path and the content is leaked via error messages. The output can optionally be cleaned using `sed`.
